summary: Key complete private-overlay sources and recursively referenced local packages instead of a filename allowlist.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Developer-only cache identity conservatively includes all private/vendor source files and local file/link/workspace package sources, excluding documented generated directories. The public five-file digest remains the first component. Unrelated overlay source changes also invalidate the cache.

recovery.detail: Missing, ambiguous or escaping local install inputs fail closed. Dependency publication, leases and retirement behavior are unchanged.
